name: broom
description: Autonomous code hygiene: sets up the formatters, linters, type checkers and language servers a repo needs, and sweeps Claude's work when it should.

format_on.title: Format
format_on.description: When broom runs formatters: on git commit, after every edit as well as on commit, or never

format_scope.title: Format scope
format_scope.description: How much of a file broom reformats: only the lines that changed (like an IDE's 'only VCS changed text'), the functions holding them (in CSS, the rules; found by the language server), or the whole file

check_on.title: Lint and type-check
check_on.description: When broom blocks on lint and type errors: on git commit, when Claude stops as well as on commit, or never
